name: Lixplore_cli
description: A Unix-inspired command-line tool for searching scientific literature, built for terminal users who want speed, automation and minimal interfaces. Search PubMed, arXiv, Crossref, DOAJ and Europe PMC in one command, deduplicate results, export to BibTeX/RIS/CSV and more, and get new-paper alerts on email, Telegram, Slack and 14 other channels.

paragraphs: A Unix-inspired command-line tool for searching scientific literature, built for terminal users who want speed, automation and minimal interfaces.

Search PubMed, arXiv, Crossref, DOAJ and Europe PMC in one command with Boolean queries, deduplicate the results, and export to 8 formats including BibTeX, RIS, EndNote and Excel. Browse and annotate papers in a full-screen TUI, and get new-paper alerts on email, Telegram, Slack and 14 other channels.
features: 🔍 Multi-Source Search - Search 5 academic databases simultaneously (PubMed, arXiv, Crossref, DOAJ, EuropePMC)
🔤 Boolean Operators - Advanced queries with AND, OR, NOT, parentheses
📊 Smart Sorting - Sort by relevance, newest, oldest, journal, or author
🔢 Smart Selection - Export odd/even, ranges, first/last N articles
💾 8 Export Formats - CSV, Excel, JSON, BibTeX, RIS, EndNote, XML
